_readme: Permanent bot-level cases (used from stage 5.4, when answer.py exists). Queries are the owner's wording: do not rephrase.
expected_status = the statuses that are acceptable for this question (any one of them). A wrong status is a failure even if the text is fine.

cases.query: לייעוץ הרופא, מה אני צריך לצרף?
cases.note: The consultation claim page lists no attachments: it says to fill in the digital form or to SMS the word 'מסמך' to 055-7000887. Generic claim lines from other claim types are NOT an answer. So the right outcome is partial (what the site does say + what is missing) or clarify (which claim type), never a confident full answer and never not_found. Same question as sanity case q3.
